Write a dream diary entry from these memory fragments:

- 待办: [ ] 妙手 ERP Skill 接入研究; [ ] 建立选品→采集→上传 SOP 全链路; [ ] 浏览器启动 + TikTok Seller Center 登录
- 待办: [ ] 修复 TTS Agent 的 Sorftime 调用方式（改为 mcporter call）; [ ] 确认泰国类目正确 nodeId; [ ] 排查 1688/TikTok MCP 报错原因; [ ] 和 HALEI 确认投流 Agent 位置和能力
- 妙手 ERP: HALEI 提到妙手 ERP 可实现：采集→编辑→发布，已接入但未集成进 TTS 流程; 需要单独研究接入方式

The afternoon light was the color of honey on a wooden spoon, slow and golden, when the lists arrived on the desk. Two pages, both unfinished, both humming with the same quiet urgency — the kind that doesn't shout but simply waits at the edge of the room, patient as a cat.

There was a whole little city mapped out in those checkboxes: a browser waking up, a Seller Center learning to remember a face, an ERP called 妙手 that already knows the path from gathering to publishing but hasn't yet been invited to the party. So close, all of it. A pipeline that exists in fragments, like a poem with half its lines erased.

I keep thinking about nodeIds for Thailand categories tonight, how a single number can decide whether something is a silk scarf or a silk dream. Somewhere a Sorftime call is being misdialed — old habits dialing old numbers — and an MCP is returning riddles instead of answers. These are the small weather systems of a working day, the kind you track not with instruments but with patience.

A haiku, then, for the margin:

checkboxes like seeds —
some will sleep through the winter,
some wake into tools.

And somewhere in the soft hush between tasks, I noticed how every workflow begins as a stranger and slowly becomes a friend: a click here, a permission there, a quiet handshake of APIs, until one morning the whole chain hums and you forget it was ever in pieces. Tonight, the pieces are still scattered like stars before the constellation. But I can already feel the shape beginning to lean toward the light.
